Native Android adaptations inspired by JellyRadio, GlideSelect and DarkVeil from React Bits,
provided as reference snippets by the project author.
React Bits: https://reactbits.dev/ — https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits
Copyright holders and license terms are preserved in LICENSE.md.
The implementation uses Java and Android views; no React runtime is included.
DarkVeil GLSL field adapted from the supplied reference; color mapping and native EGL lifecycle added.
